intro: Gameweek 8, gentlemen, and the table did absolutely nothing. Not one place changed hands, so the title race is ON in the sense that Ben still has a 37-point cushion. Brahmes dropped 61 on us, the top score of the week, and still sits sixth. Jack was next best on 58, and Josh's 49 was the best of the rest. Jamie propped up the week on 37 and is 54 points adrift of everyone else. Ben led on 418 despite a modest 40, while Asher is second on 381 and Jonny third on 364. Bournemouth beat Man Utd 3-0 and Arsenal and Liverpool both kept clean sheets, so defenders were rinsed for points all weekend. Absolute scenes.
motw: Brahmes, 61 points, and he sits sixth. N.Jackson banged in two for 13, Araujo and Virgil both kept clean sheets for Liverpool and Barnes chipped in with a goal. A big week that moves the needle on the table by precisely nothing. Still, you can't buy that.
stinker: Jamie, 37 points, bottom of the week and bottom of the table. Hill got 11 and not much else did. Three waiver moves and still the lowest score, which takes some doing. Squeaky bum time at the wrong end.
bench: Jonny left 14 points on the bench, and 10 of them were Truffert, who had an assist and a clean sheet for Bournemouth. Truffert sat there like a trophy in a cabinet. The bench is where points go to die, and Jonny has dug the grave.
bench_jam: Brahmes had Araujo come on for Matheus N. and the sub banked 10 points: clean sheet, 2 bonus and 11 defensive contributions. That is a proper bench jam. Set and forget, gentlemen, set and forget.
red_card: Ben owns Palmer, who got sent off against Spurs in a 0-2 Chelsea loss. He finished on -1 after 79 minutes. Ben still leads the league by 37 points, so it hurts less than it should. A red card with a cushion, as they say.
gloves: Jamie's Penders had three saves, conceded twice and scored an own goal in the 0-2 Chelsea defeat. That is 0 points for a keeper who made the waiver move this very week. Sunday League stuff, and the gloves go to Jamie for the second time this column.

xi.385: Trafford kept a clean sheet for Leeds, made four saves and picked up three bonus points. Josh's keeper had a ten-point week. Never in doubt.
xi.4: Gabriel scored, kept a clean sheet and banked bonus for 17 points. Top of the shop for Jack, and a worldie of a week for a defender.
xi.31: Konsa scored for Arsenal and got 14 points. Ben's defender did the business while his captain-less side cruised on.
xi.60: Hill had 22 defensive contributions and 3 bonus for 11 points. Jamie's best player on a bad week.
xi.10: White got an assist and a clean sheet for Arsenal. Ten points for Asher, who is a solid second in the table.
xi.580: Araujo came on for the sub and returned 10 points for Brahmes. A clean sheet and 2 bonus off the bench. Absolute scenes.
xi.68: Tavernier scored in the 3-0 Bournemouth win and got a clean sheet too. Ten points for Ben from a midfielder.
xi.67: Rayan scored for Bournemouth and had 17 defensive contributions. Ten points for Jack, who is quietly having a lovely week.
xi.166: N.Jackson scored twice for Villa against Man City and got full bonus. Thirteen points for Brahmes and the top of the heap.
xi.465: Osula scored for Newcastle in the 2-0 win at Palace and picked up three bonus. Nine points for Josh, who is buzzing.
xi.379: Isak scored for Liverpool against Brighton and got three bonus for nine points. Jonny had a good forward line and a bad bench.
